description: Schema definition for Company entity that stores core company information

id.desc: Unique identifier for the company like a UUID

systemVersion.desc: Version identifier for the company record (if applicable)

timestamp.desc: Timestamp representing when the record was last updated, in Int64 format

name.desc: The official legal name of the company

displayName.desc: A user-friendly name for display purposes, like a username

businessProfileId.desc: Identifier linking the company to its associated business profile

systemCreatedAt.desc: Datetime when the company record was created in the system

systemCreatedBy.desc: Identifier for the user or system process that created the record

systemModifiedAt.desc: Datetime when the company record was last modified

systemModifiedBy.desc: Identifier for the user or system process that last modified the record
